rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be 18 or older to apply for the First Homes scheme

rules.description: Applicant must be a first-time buyer
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a first-time buyer to be eligible for the First Homes scheme

rules.description: Applicant must be able to get a mortgage for at least half the property price
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be able to get a mortgage for at least half the price of the home

rules.description: Annual income must not exceed £80,000 (outside London)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your annual income exceeds the £80,000 cap for areas outside London

rules.description: Annual income must not exceed £90,000 (London only)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your annual income exceeds the £90,000 cap for London properties

rules.description: For joint applications, all applicants must be first-time buyers
rules.reason_if_failed: All buyers in a joint application must be first-time buyers

rules.description: Property price after discount must not exceed £250,000 (outside London)
rules.reason_if_failed: The property price after discount exceeds the £250,000 cap for areas outside London

rules.description: Property price after discount must not exceed £420,000 (London only)
rules.reason_if_failed: The property price after discount exceeds the £420,000 cap for London properties

rules.description: Property must be located in England
rules.reason_if_failed: The First Homes scheme is only available for properties in England

edge_cases.action: All applicants must meet first-time buyer criteria. Joint income is the total of all applicants' income from the previous tax year. Only one applicant needs to meet local criteria (e.g., key worker or area resident).

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a member of armed forces or qualifying family member
edge_cases.action: Exempt from local criteria (key worker, area resident requirements). Still must meet all other First Homes eligibility criteria including income caps and first-time buyer status.

edge_cases.description: Local council has set additional eligibility requirements
edge_cases.action: Priority may be given to key workers, area residents, or lower income households for first 3 months of property sale. After 3 months, these local criteria no longer apply.

edge_cases.description: Mortgage application is declined after initial eligibility check
edge_cases.action: Application cannot proceed. Applicant may need to improve credit rating, increase deposit, or seek mortgage advice. Reservation fee will be refunded if paid.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's circumstances change before contract exchange
edge_cases.action: Applicant must inform conveyancer immediately. If no longer eligible (e.g., income increased above cap, purchased another property), application will be rejected.

edge_cases.description: New build property requires reservation fee
edge_cases.action: Applicant may need to pay reservation fee to developer. Fee is refundable if application is unsuccessful.
